title: Paper White 2: the groups of wild encounter areas, res/paperwhite2/encounters/groups.json
description: Areas that a habitat or an outbreak can name together as "group:<id>". The editor's import makes one for each parent zone with several areas; the rest are the user's. Packed by tools/paperwhite2/encounters.py, which gives each named group's areas their own entries.

custom.description: The user's own, rather than one of a parent zone; false by default
